items.title: Ray Blue interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 23, 2022
items.q: One of the records I got from the Columbia Record Club was “Miles Davis in Europe.” ... Sonny introduced me to five schools of jazz: Trane, Miles, Monk, Ornette

ctx.x: So why? Why did you at that early age have this idea that Europe was going to be significant?

One of the records I got from the Columbia Record Club was “Miles Davis in Europe.” And you know I played it on my little hi-fi and you could hear how the music and the audience, the musicians and the audience just came together. They were somewhere in France because I remember the announcement was in French. And I just had that dream. That’s what I want to do. Yeah. And I was twelve. That’s what I wanted to do and I didn’t know how I was going to get it done but that was the goal, the dream. And so I moved over…

Ensemble at the time too, and we were doing things, mostly in France. But I was there, I went to Germany and Switzerland and I met different people and I was mapping out a plan. And I was back I think maybe a week and I got a phone call and I was invited to come and play some festivals with some folks in Switzerland in September. So that was in, I believe it was in May, end of May beginning of June I got the call. And the dates went in the book and that was it. So I left on September 20th, 2000. I had a…
